title: Nameplate Line of Sight
description: This mod hides nameplates when obstructed by blocks. Useful for when you have many named armor stands in your world.
body:
# Single Purpose Mod
This mod addresses a simple problem- having too many named armor stands in your world. Especially if you're a content creator with many armor stands for viewers, it really ruins the aesthetics seeing names through all of your builds. This mod fixes this issue!

Nameplates will ONLY render within the player's line of sight. If a nameplate is behind blocks, it will not render. Simple as that.
